name: M5 — Decide the mobile strategy (A / B / C)
description:
Decision gate for the mobile refactor. Read, in this order: docs/mobile/status-verification-delta.md (v2 corrections — authoritative over v1), docs/mobile/mockups-brief.md, then docs/mobile/approaches/01-shell-first.md, 02-adaptive-pages.md, 03-launcher-stack.md.

Deliverable: fill the decision record in docs/mobile/README.md (§4) with the chosen approach, rationale, rejected option and the M1 scope.

Decision input — the shared foundation is identical in all three approaches: useViewport() as the only breakpoint source, one shell owning scroll + safe areas, a /desktop device guard, a mounted navigation surface, and the D6 fix (src/components/ChatEntry.vue imports ./ChatEntryMobile.vue which does not exist).

Summary: A = wrap screens in one shell, ~1 sprint, low risk, fixes D1-D4/D6/D7/D9, leaves D5/D8/D10 and all duplication. B = one adaptive component per screen with two densities, 2-3 sprints, medium-high risk, fixes D1-D10 and the whole duplication map. C = launcher + per-module stack + MOBILE_APPS registry, 3-4 sprints, high risk, phone as its own product surface.

Blocking questions listed in docs/mobile/README.md §5 (mobile as support surface vs first-class surface; whether ChatEntryMobile is created or the fork deleted; whether the chat/workspaces/browsers duplicate pairs are in scope; who owns the "fits on a phone" classification of the 35 apps).

Acceptance: a decided approach, a named feature flag, and a demo viewport list (390x844 and 768x1024).
